tools.name: verify_native_usdc
tools.title: Verify native USDC transaction
tools.description: Inspect a completed native Circle USDC transfer by transaction hash on a supported chain (Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Ethereum, Avalanche or Solana). Use for transaction evidence; use match_native_usdc_payment to require an exact recipient and six-decimal amount, or usdc_transfer_evidence_pdf to obtain a PDF. This call does not initiate transfers or establish payment to a particular invoice. Costs 0.02 USDC via x402 v2; the paid MCP accepts Base or Solana USDC subject to wallet approval. Public-chain RPC finality and availability vary.

tx_hash.description: Public transaction to inspect: 0x plus 64 hex characters for EVM; base58 64-byte Solana signature. Must match network.

network.description: Blockchain inspected; the separate API payment always settles native USDC on Base.
Blockchain inspected; the separate API payment always settles native USDC on Base.

_meta.io.skavio/result-encoding: Success JSON in content text; unpaid PaymentRequired in structuredContent. Preserve params._meta[x402/payment] on retry.

tools.name: match_native_usdc_payment
tools.title: Match exact USDC recipient and amount
tools.description: Confirm an exact native Circle USDC recipient and six-decimal transfer amount for a completed transaction on a supported EVM chain or Solana, with chain-specific finality checks. Use when reconciling a payment with an expected wallet and amount; for inspecting a transfer without expected values choose verify_native_usdc; for a PDF choose usdc_transfer_evidence_pdf. Requires tx_hash, recipient and amount, does not send funds or create an invoice. Costs 0.03 USDC via x402 v2; paid MCP wallets can pay native USDC on Base or Solana.

tx_hash.description: Public transaction to inspect: 0x plus 64 hex characters for EVM; base58 64-byte Solana signature. Must match network.

network.description: Blockchain inspected; the separate API payment always settles native USDC on Base.

recipient.description: Expected recipient: EVM 0x address or Solana owner wallet, not a token account.

amount.description: Positive exact USDC decimal string, at most six decimal places. Never a floating point number.

network.description: Blockchain inspected; the separate API payment always settles native USDC on Base.

matched.description: True only for exactly one matching transfer after required finality.

_meta.io.skavio/result-encoding: Success JSON in content text; unpaid PaymentRequired in structuredContent. Preserve params._meta[x402/payment] on retry.

tools.name: usdc_transfer_evidence_pdf
tools.title: USDC blockchain transfer evidence PDF
tools.description: Generate a bounded base64-encoded PDF containing publicly verifiable native Circle USDC transaction evidence for an existing on-chain transfer. Use when a customer or accountant needs a downloadable blockchain proof, not when you need a machine-readable exact recipient and amount check (use match_native_usdc_payment) or a simple transaction lookup (use verify_native_usdc). The PDF is not an invoice, tax receipt or authorization. No custody or transfers. Costs 0.05 USDC via x402 v2 on Base or Solana MCP.

tx_hash.description: Public transaction to inspect: 0x plus 64 hex characters for EVM; base58 64-byte Solana signature. Must match network.

network.description: Blockchain inspected; the separate API payment always settles native USDC on Base.

tools.name: domain_dns_tls_audit
tools.title: Public domain DNS and TLS audit
tools.description: Audit the public DNS records and TLS certificate of ONE public hostname, using bounded DNS resolution and a TLS handshake to port 443. Use for a basic hostname/certificate check; do not use for web content fetching (web_fetch), page extraction (web_extract), vulnerability scanning, port scanning or private IP networks. Input is a hostname such as example.com, not a URL. Returns TLS validity, resolved public IPs, TLS version and certificate expiry where available; no HTTP request. Costs 0.05 native USDC via x402 v2 on Base or Solana MCP.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname, for example example.com; no URL, IP, credentials or private host.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.title: Web fetch
tools.description: Retrieve content from a public HTTPS document under robots.txt, SSRF and byte limits. Use for a source fetch; choose web_extract when only human-visible text is needed and web_monitor for content change hashes. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API key, an enabled backend operation and an accepted payment mode. x402 returns a workload-specific quote and prepaid consumes shared company credits. Retry with the SAME idempotency_key and inputs to recover, not a new job. Admission is not delivery: poll skavio_agent_job_status, retrieve through skavio_agent_job_result, and verify SHA256. No anonymous execution.

url.description: Public HTTPS page URL. Robots, public address and bounded response checks apply.

arguments.description: Tool-specific structured input object. Supply the required named fields described by its JSON Schema; source bytes must respect encoded size limits. Never include wallet private keys, passwords or API tokens.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Stable job key; retry exactly the same inputs and payment mode with this key to recover safely.

payment_mode.title: Payment Mode
payment_mode.description: x402 returns a workload-specific quote; prepaid spends your existing shared company credits. No anonymous execution.

io.skavio/result-schema.description: PaymentRequired, durable job admission, or explicit error. Admission is not delivery; poll owned status then result and verify SHA256.

error.description: Explicit failure code; no success/delivery implied.
